answer: Sybil resistance comes from a bonded identity vault: each agent must lock a stake before it can vote or earn, while a falcon watcher flags clusters sharing funding or timing. Colluding nodes forfeit their bond, so an attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand separate deposits, and one shared funding trail can burn them all. Minting identities stays as cheap as shale dust, but buying influence costs real capital that scales with every fake agent.
